name: Potatoes Anna
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Slice the potatoes thinly. Press slices against absorbent paper to dry.
Brush the tin with melted butter. Layer the potato slices into the tin, brushing each layer with butter and ending with butter on the top.
Cover and bake in the oven for 20 minutes. Uncover and cook for a further 30 minutes.

culture.text: Pommes Anna, or Anna potatoes, is a classic French dish of sliced, layered potatoes cooked in a very large amount of melted butter. There are several variants of the dish, containing, in addition to potatoes and butter, other ingredients, which may include artichoke hearts, black truffles, mushrooms and cheese.
